_about: States baked into the final dev test zip (docs: CLAUDE.md, 'Final dev build'). Each game: its releases as No-Intro names (checked against src/dumps_data.h), each with slots 1-9 -> [fixture state in gba-ds-tests/states/<game>/, what to check]. tools/make_device_states.py writes <name>.slotN.state files; scripts/build-rocknix.sh puts them in the zip's states/ folder when GBADS_DEVICE_STATES names the output folder.

1: fx-title.ss
Title (this release's saves don't fit, so only the logo is tested): the logo (BOF-1)
us-main-menu.ss
Main menu, the cursor on Deck Edit: the logo, idle (UM6-4, UM6-6). Same for the title screen; the Europe release asks for a language first
2: A duel's first turn, Draw Phase, the cursor on your Deck with the Draw prompt: the logo, idle, nothing to show yet (UM6-3, UM6-5). Press A to draw: the cursor goes to a card in your hand and its Card View comes up (UM6-1)
3: A duel, your Main Phase, the cursor free on a card in your hand: its Card View. Move LEFT / RIGHT along the hand: it follows (UM6-1)
4: us-monster.ss
The cursor on your face-up monster: its Card View. Press UP into an empty zone: the last Card View stays; press RIGHT along the row (UM6-1, UM6-3)
5: The cursor on a card you set in your Magic and Trap row: its Card View, face-down card too (UM6-1)
6: The phase menu open (B): the last Card View stays, no prompt copied (UM6-3). Pick End Phase / EP: the End Phase banner, the last Card View stays, then the opponent's turn (UM6-3, UM6-5)
7: The opponent's turn under way: the logo, idle; the cursor isn't yours. Wait for your Draw Phase: the logo until the cursor is on a card (UM6-5)
8: Load slot 3, then this: the opponent's life points are 0 (the duel is won): the logo, idle, the last Card View forgotten (UM6-4). Let the game carry on to the Duel Results: still the logo

1: us-hand.ss
Your turn, cursor on a hand card (Autonomous Action Unit): its Card View within about a second (YWC-1). Move to other hand cards: the page follows.
2: The hand card's commands already open (Set / Card View): the Card View is shown (YWC-1).
3: Cursor on an empty field zone, no card looked at yet: the logo (YWC-3). Move onto a card: its Card View; back to the empty zone: that card stays.
4: us-end-menu.ss

'End your turn?' up: the second screen doesn't change (logo here, YWC-3). Answer YES: the logo through the opponent's whole turn, whatever card it shows or attacks with (YWC-8); when your turn comes round the logo stays through the Draw Phase, and after you draw the card's Card View returns (YWC-1).
5: Draw Phase before drawing, the cursor already on a hand card (Fissure): its Card View (YWC-1). Move it to the Deck: the card stays; A on the Deck draws; the drawn card's Card View follows when the cursor is on it.
6: Edit Deck's Deck mode, cursor on Blue-Eyes White Dragon: its Detail (YWC-2). Move the cursor down: each card's Detail follows.
7: Deck select list: the logo (YWC-3/4; A, A opens Deck mode on the hidden copy, nothing taken). Press A, A yourself to reach Deck mode (as slot 6).
8: The title screen: the logo, the same picture as the title's lettering (YWC-4, YWC-5).
9: us-opp-turn.ss
In the opponent's turn (its Goblin Attack Force is named in the info bar): the logo, not that card (YWC-8). Let it play on, then your turn: the logo until you draw and the cursor is on a card.

1: jp-opp-turn.ss
The opponent's turn (the game itself shows its summoned card large): the logo on the second screen (YWC-8). Let it play on to your turn: the logo until the cursor is on a card.
2: The card binder (Volume.1): another screen, the logo (YWC-4).
3: Deck select, the deck list: the logo (YWC-4). Move into the cards (right) and A, A: their Detail, as slot 4.
4: jp-deck-select-cards.ss
Deck select with the cursor in a deck's cards (Deck mode): the Detail of the card under it (YWC-2). Move the cursor: the page follows.
5: Draw Phase before drawing, the cursor on a hand card: its Card View (YWC-1). Move to the Deck: the card stays; A on the Deck draws.
6: A hand card's commands open (詳細表示): its Card View (YWC-1).
7: 'End your turn?' up: the second screen doesn't change (logo here). Answer はい: the logo through the opponent's turn (YWC-8).
8: The duel field arriving, nothing named: the logo (YWC-3).
9: jp-title.ss
The title of a first start: the logo, the title's lettering (YWC-5, YWC-7).
